feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
entry.summary: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

entry.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
entry.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

entry.title: Special education head at Education Department abruptly resigns
entry.summary: The leader of the Education Department's special education office told employees she is resigning after less than four months in the role and as the agency overall is morphing and shrinking.

entry.title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
entry.summary: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

entry.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
entry.summary: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

entry.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
entry.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?
entry.summary: Bangladesh has seen over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases of measles this year. The death toll among children just surpassed 1,000. How are officials trying to bring the outbreak under control?

entry.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
entry.summary: A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

entry.title: Cargo jet tried to abort unsteady landing before Miami crash, flight data indicates
entry.summary: Flight data suggest an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before smashing into a van and killing five people inside, according to information investigators released Tuesday.

entry.title: National Guard member arrested after drawing gun on fellow soldier in D.C.
entry.summary: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.
